Path 3, compositionGOALS §10.1

kro

Lightweight resource-graph composition with YAML and CEL.

WHAT IT IS

Kube Resource Orchestrator: ResourceGraphDefinitions turn a group of Kubernetes resources into one custom API, wired together with CEL.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Composition without the weight of a full Crossplane install; backed by AWS, Google and Microsoft, and pairs with ACK on EKS. Through function-kro it also runs inside Crossplane.

WHERE WE STAND

Watch. Relevant if Crossplane's weight becomes the objection, and less either-or than it looked last year. ⚠️ Check its release and stability first.

"Achieving Cross-Cloud Portability with kro"; Crossplane function-kro, KubeCon NA 2026
